subject: PO number + line-item corrections for SurgeCloud onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vasile <elena@surgecloud.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: SurgeCloud — onboarding form + PO guidance

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. To get Sur geCloud set up in our vendor system we need: 1) the completed vendor onboarding form (attached), 2) a copy of your W-9 (or VAT form if applicable), and 3) bank ACH details for payment.

A couple of procurement notes for PO and invoicing:
- Redwood requires a PO number to be referenced on all invoices. We prefer the PO on the invoice header and line items to map to the same account codes.
- For initial onboarding we typically set a provisional spend cap; please indicate if any line items are one-time professional services versus ongoing subscription so we can set the right spend controls.

I attached our standard vendor form — if you can return the completed PDF and the invoice draft (an example XLSX is fine) we'll route it to Finance to issue a PO. Rishi/Monica: please confirm the spend cap process and whether we can issue a provisional PO while tax docs clear.

Simple next steps: Elena — send completed form + invoice draft. Rishi/Monica — confirm spend cap and whether we can issue a PO this week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
attachments: surgecloud_vendor_form.pdf (PDF)
From: Elena Vasile <elena@surgecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@surgecloud.com
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: SurgeCloud — onboarding form + PO guidance

Hi Marissa — thanks for the note and the checklist. Attached: completed vendor onboarding form and our invoice draft (line items broken into subscription + implementation). W-9 attached as well.

A few clarifications from our side:
- The implementation fees (one-time) are listed as a separate line item.
- Subscription is invoiced monthly in arrears; we can change the invoice to show the Redwood PO line references if you need that.
- Net 30 payment terms on the invoice — if you need Net 45 for onboarding, let us know.

Placeholder attachments: Sur geCloud_invoice_draft.xlsx (XLSX), surgecloud_vendor_form_filled.pdf (PDF), W9_SurgeCloud.pdf (PDF)

If you can confirm the PO/line-item mapping and any spend cap we’ll update the invoice and re-send.

Thanks,
Elena Vasile
Head of Partnerships
SurgeCloud Inc.
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: SurgeCloud — onboarding form + PO guidance

Marissa / Elena — quick internal note from Finance: we can issue a provisional PO while the tax docs complete, but we need the invoice draft with line-item GL mapping to set spend caps correctly.

Proposal: issue PO with a contractual annual cap of $75,000 for the subscription service, with separate one-time cap of $18,000 for implementation (PO will reference two line items). If the vendor expects a different cadence or cap, flag now.

Monica — can you draft PO-REDWOOD-2025-1137 and confirm whether the procurement system requires any additional vendor codes?

Thanks,
Rishi
Finance Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Vasile <elena@surgecloud.com>, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: SurgeCloud — PO prepared + line-item corrections

All — I prepared the PO and uploaded it to the procurement system. Notes:
- PO number: PO-REDWOOD-2025-1137 (attached PDF). Please reference this on all future invoices.
- Spend caps set as discussed: subscription (annual cap) $75,000; implementation (one-time) $18,000.
- Line-item corrections made: your original invoice mapped the subscription to account 7200 (SaaS) — I changed it to 7212 (Managed Services - ML infra) per product owner guidance. Implementation is on 8100 (Professional Services).
- Payment terms: Net 30 as requested.

Elena: I left a comment in the invoice draft to include the PO number in the header and to break the first invoice into subscription (pro-rated) + final implementation milestone invoice.

Attachments: PO-REDWOOD-2025-1137.pdf (PDF)

Monica Patel
Sr. Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Vasile <elena@surgecloud.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@surgecloud.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: SurgeCloud — PO confirmed

Thanks Monica — confirmed. We'll update the invoice header to include PO-REDWOOD-2025-1137 and split the first billing as you suggested. Expect the corrected invoice and the signed onboarding form back by EOD tomorrow.

One minor ask: for future invoices can you include the Redwood project code (provided on the PO) in the invoice line description so our AR team can auto-match? If there's a specific format let me know and we'll conform.
